Cultural and economic transfers between generations, essay.
Marital transition and depression among mothers.

Book review of Lee and Campbell on Liaoning.
Introduction to a symposium on the family life-cycle in traditional and modern Japan, contrasting household size and marriage age with the European pattern. Framing for the extended arm.
Intergenerational support to elderly parents in Vietnam by family size and children's location; co-residence with married children is an outcome, support the object.
No abstract; family structure and cardiovascular activity is decisive on subject.
Review of cannabis use and educational attainment.

NCDS 1958 cohort: family disruption between 7 and 16 against early school leaving, LEAVING HOME EARLY and TEENAGE FIRST BIRTH, net of pre-disruption background. Both links in one longitudinal design with a pre-determined exposure -- the structure §3 asks for, though the exposure is disruption rather than the arrangement. Priority full-text read.
Youth transition to adulthood in preindustrial northern Sweden. Pre-modern; A.7's under Ruling 2.
Contact of young married Korean women with their NON-coresident parents and parents-in-law; contact frequency is the outcome.
